subject: Staggered walkthrough windows — align pilot with finance reforecast
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Tom Brooks <t.brooks@cedarline.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staggered walkthrough windows — align pilot with finance reforecast

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the time earlier this week. Based on your note about the finance reforecast and the CFO travel window, I wanted to propose a couple of ways to keep momentum while respecting Cedarline's approval cadence:

1) Staggered sessions: technical deep-dive for engineering + SRE on 10/21 (60–75m), executive overview and commercial Q&A after the reforecast on 10/29 (30–45m).
2) Single after-reforecast session: hold everything until the finance update (would push to the week of 10/26 or later).

If the stagger works, we can tailor the technical session to be hands-on (sample inference run, perf numbers, KV cache walkthrough) and then hand over a concise package for your CFO/Finance ahead of the exec call. I've attached a one-pager that summarizes pilot scope, success metrics, and pricing.

Open questions from our side: does your procurement team need a PO before an exec-level session? If so we can provide a procurement checklist to speed review.

Options are listed below — pick what reduces overhead on your side and we'll block time:
• Tech session: Wed 10/21, 11:00–12:15 PT — engineer-friendly timeslot
• Exec overview: Thu 10/29, 10:00–10:45 PT — after reforecast

If none of these work, share a couple slots and we’ll adapt.

Attachments: pilot-onepager.pdf (summary + success metrics)

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Brooks <t.brooks@cedarline.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@cedarline.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staggered walkthrough windows — align pilot with finance reforecast

Priya —

Appreciate the clear options. Quick context: our CFO is on travel from 10/20–10/28 and the finance reforecast will be final on 10/25. Procurement tends to lock POs around the reforecast outcome, so if we hold the exec ask until 10/29 that makes the most sense for approvals.

That said, I like the idea of a targeted technical session for our platform and SRE team while leadership is OOO — it helps the engineering team validate the integration surface and performance assumptions ahead of procurement. So let's do the staggered approach.

Can you send an agenda for the tech session and confirm what we need to have ready (sample dataset, network diagrams, firewall egress)? Also, procurement asked whether a pilot commitment or signed MSA is required prior to the exec call. If you can provide a procurement checklist and a sample one-page SOW/fees that would help.

Thanks — I’ll tentatively hold the 10/21 and 10/29 slots on our side pending your artifacts.

Tom Brooks
Director, Cloud Platform
Cedarline Systems
Tom.Brooks@cedarline.com | +1 206-555-1221

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Brooks <t.brooks@cedarline.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staggered walkthrough windows — align pilot with finance reforecast

Tom —

Thanks for the quick context and for tentatively holding time. We’ll execute exactly as you suggested:

- Technical session (Wed 10/21, 11:00–12:15 PT): hands-on demo, sample inference with your dataset, memory/latency profile, KV cache explanation, and integration checklist. Bring a pair of engineers with network access to validate egress rules.
- Executive overview (Thu 10/29, 10:00–10:45 PT): concise ROI-focused deck and procurement next steps.

I’ve attached an updated agenda and a procurement checklist to this thread (pilot-agenda-v2.docx, procurement-checklist.xlsx). We’ll also prep a one-page SOW and an MSA summary for your procurement team; that will be in the exec packet.

On commercial levers: our motion here is to remove procedural friction — if Cedarline signs a pilot SOW by 10/31 we can lock an introductory pilot rate and offer a demo-to-pilot onboarding credit (I’ll confirm internal approval and share numbers before the exec call). If procurement needs a PO early, we can accept a placeholder PO with final SOW to follow.

Agenda highlights for the tech session:
• 10m — quick intros + success metrics
• 25m — live inference run (representative dataset)
• 20m — performance/ops discussion (latency, batching, KV cache)
• 15m — integration Q&A + next steps

Anything else you want in the tech agenda? If not, we’ll lock the invites.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Tom Brooks <t.brooks@cedarline.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@cedarline.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staggered walkthrough windows — align pilot with finance reforecast

On Thu, Oct 15, 2026 at 9:12 AM Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time earlier this week. Based on your note about the finance reforecast and the CFO travel window, I wanted to propose a couple of ways to keep momentum while respecting Cedarline's approval cadence:

All — thanks, this plan works for us. We’ll run the tech session on 10/21 with two engineers and a network lead. I’ve asked procurement to prepare a placeholder PO in case we need it; they’ll send the PO if that helps your onboarding.

For the exec session on 10/29, please send the short exec deck and the SOW in advance (ideally before 10/27) so the CFO has time to review after the reforecast. Procurement also asked that we provide a sample DocuSign link for the SOW/MSA flow so they can check internal routing.

I’ll confirm the attendee list for both sessions on Monday. If you can send the DocuSign template and the one-page SOW as soon as they’re available that will speed up the approval path.

Procurement will be on standby for a PO; they prefer a single-line PO referencing the pilot SOW.

Tom Brooks
Director, Cloud Platform
Cedarline Systems

Attachments referenced: procurement-checklist.xlsx
